record.title: Oman January 2021 land closure
record.movement: General land travellers; June easing for Omanis and GCC residents living in Oman and working in neighbouring countries
record.exceptions: The February 10 continuation exempted trucks and permitted Omani citizens to return until February 21 at 10:00 under institutional isolation. June 2 subsequently permitted qualifying cross-border work commuters with employer proof.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no current-status inference
record.official_rationale: Control new coronavirus variant and quarantine non-compliance.
record.context: General closure later eased for cross-border workers.
record.uncertainty: January 18 at 18:00 is the initial ordered onset; January 25 is scheduled expiry only. The February continuation included truck and citizen-return exceptions. June 2 is limited commuter permission, not full reopening or observed resumption; no continuous January–June all-passenger spell or operational Saudi crossing is inferred.

historical.duration_note: Formal change of permission; operational reopening and continuous effective duration not established
